headline: Content Distribution & Promotion
keyNotes: Surprisingly, 7 out of 10 business buyers trust what other people like them say more than what a company itself says, highlighting the power of real-world opinions.
When looking for people to help spread your message, it's more important to find those who truly influence others and get results, rather than just picking someone with a lot of followers.
Even with all the new ways to reach people, email is still a very powerful tool for businesses, delivering the best return on investment (meaning, for every dollar you spend, you get the most back).
The ways people find and consume information are constantly changing, so businesses need to regularly update how they share their content to keep reaching their audience.

Getting attention for your business without paying for ads, often called 'earned media,' is becoming very important again, especially with how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people search for information.
question: The article highlights that audiences are always moving and that people often trust what others say more than what a company says. Thinking about your own work or business, how do you currently figure out where your customers are actually spending their time and whose opinions they truly value, beyond just your own company's message?
